description: resilience workload profile definitions. Every profile stays under the proxy-security proxy rate limits by construction (see infrastructure/docker/reverse-proxy/nginx.conf for the pinned limits) — no profile here is allowed to raise or bypass them.

idle.description: No synthetic traffic beyond container healthchecks. Baseline for cold-start/warm-idle resource measurement.

normal.description: Steady single-user-equivalent browser traffic: real Chromium + Firefox sessions producing views, actions, browser logs, resources, Web Vitals, and controlled errors, well under rate limits.

burst.description: Short spike of concurrent sessions/actions intended to approach (never exceed, by design) the proxy-security rate limit so 429s are the controlled failure mode, not 5xx/timeout.

sustained.description: Longer steady mixed load. Three named durations so CI, standard acceptance, and extended soak runs share one profile shape.

mixed.description: Concurrent telemetry ingest, dashboard query, alert evaluation, runtime-control polling, and operator-status calls in the same window, to catch cross-path interference the isolated profiles above cannot.

outage-recovery.description: Load continues while a target service is stopped/restarted mid-run; measures detection, unready duration, and recovery under active load rather than at rest.
